Command line helpers of manim cfg and manim init

Source: R/cli_helpers.R
value_from_string.Rd

The helpers behind the prompts of manim cfg write and manim init (manim_cli()), as upstream's manim.cli.cfg.group and manim.cli.init.commands.

Usage

value_from_string(value)

replace_keys(default)

select_resolution()

update_cfg(cfg_dict, project_cfg_path)

Arguments

value

A string.

default

A named list or vector.

cfg_dict

Named list of settings.

project_cfg_path

Path of a manim.cfg.

Value

value_from_string() the literal; replace_keys() default renamed; select_resolution() an integer vector; update_cfg() the path, invisibly.

Details

  • value_from_string(value) reads a config value as a Python literal: "5" is 5L, "1.5" is 1.5, "True" is TRUE, "0,0" a list of two integers; anything else ("BLACK", "60%") stays a string.

  • replace_keys(default) swaps _ and . in the names, as the logger section is shown to the user.

  • select_resolution() asks for a resolution among the qualities and returns c(height, width) (default 480p).

  • update_cfg(cfg_dict, project_cfg_path) sets [CLI] keys of a manim.cfg; resolution sets pixel_height and pixel_width.

Outside an interactive session every prompt takes its default.

Examples

value_from_string("60")
#> [1] 60
value_from_string("0,0")
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> attr(,"py_type")
#> [1] "tuple"
value_from_string("BLACK")
#> [1] "BLACK"
replace_keys(list(log_width = "-1", logging.keyword = "bold yellow"))
#> $log.width
#> [1] "-1"
#> 
#> $logging_keyword
#> [1] "bold yellow"
#> 
select_resolution()
#> 
#> Select resolution:
#>  (2160p, 1440p, 1080p, 720p, 480p): 
#> [1] 480 854
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".cfg")
writeLines(c("[CLI]", "frame_rate = 60"), f)
update_cfg(list(frame_rate = 30, resolution = c(480, 854)), f)
readLines(f)
#> [1] "[CLI]"              "frame_rate = 30"    "pixel_height = 480"
#> [4] "pixel_width = 854"  ""
